tutorial.title: Tutorial {n}/{total}
tutorial.camera: Drag (or one finger) to move, scroll or pinch to zoom. Try moving a little.
tutorial.road: Open Infrastructure, pick Dirt road and drag to lay at least 5 road tiles.
tutorial.hut: Open Housing and place a Hut next to the road. Green means it fits; the list says why.
tutorial.food: People need food: open Food and place a Berry field near the houses.
tutorial.well: Place a Well (Services) near the huts so they upgrade into cottages.
tutorial.inspect: Click a house to see what it needs to upgrade, and why.
tutorial.finish: That's enough to start! Follow the chapter goals on the left. Space pauses, P plans, B opens the encyclopedia.
